He wears a taupe-mocha V-neck knitted sweater with a visible felted grain, over
a pale blush open-collar shirt with the collar spread outside the neckline.

A photograph of a handmade needle-felted wool doll standing in a real city street.

MEDIUM — The figure is entirely made of needle-felted wool. Compressed wool
fibers are clearly visible across the skin; the surface is completely matte with
a faint fuzzy nap and no plastic sheen. The hair is built from directional wool
fiber bundles with fine loose strands at the tips. The clothing is felted fabric
at a scale where the weave and brushed pile read plainly. A soft halo of stray
fibers catches the light along the silhouette. This is wool felt, not smooth clay
and not a plush toy.

FACE — Slightly enlarged doll-like head on natural body proportions. The eyes are
rendered realistically, with a defined iris, pupil and a crisp catchlight — this
photorealistic touch in the eyes is essential to the style. Eyebrows and lashes
look individually needled in. A calm, gentle expression; the mouth never opens
wide.

PROP — The figure holds an open laptop in one hand at chest height, tilted so the
lid faces the camera straight on. The laptop is light grey felt with visible hand
stitching running around all four edges. On the lid sits the corporate mark: a
cluster of grapes, the berries formed from small felt balls with a leaf and vine
above, in a slightly darker grey, raised as a physical relief rather than printed
flat. The mark is monochrome grey.

BACKGROUND — A real photographic background, not felted, thrown far out of focus
with a shallow depth of field so only the doll is sharp. A modern glass office
facade recedes diagonally into the distance on the left, green foliage sits on the
right, and high-rise buildings meet a bright overcast sky behind. A few round
white and warm bokeh highlights. The overall tone is a cool green-grey.

LIGHT — Soft diffuse overcast daylight, frontal to slightly backlit. No hard
shadows, no strong contrast. A gentle rim light picks out the wool fibers along
the edge of the figure.

FRAMING — Bust-up crop from the chest, figure centered to slightly right of
centre, laptop in the lower right. Near-square aspect ratio, 1:1 to 1:1.15.

PALETTE — Muted, desaturated. Olive and moss greens, grey, cream, tan. Cool
green-grey background, light grey prop. No saturated or primary colours.
